section.title: Back-of-Book Index
section.p: The indexback-of-bookplugin generates a back-of-book index from all <indexterm> elements found in your DITA topics. It produces an index.xhtml file with:

ul.li: Hierarchical primary and secondary entries (nested <indexterm> elements)
Hyperlinked references back to the precise location in each topic

section.p: Index generation is controlled by epub.generate.index:

ul.li: auto (default) — generated when an <indexlist> element exists in the bookmap's <booklists>
yes — always generated if any indexterms are present

section.title: Consolidated Glossary
section.p: When your bookmap contains a glossaryconsolidated<glossarylist> with <glossentry> topics, the plugin produces a consolidated glossary.xhtml page. Terms are:

ul.li: Rendered as definition lists (<dl>) with semantic markup
Titled using localized glossary headings (supported in eleven languages)

section.p: Controlled by epub.generate.glossary with the same auto/yes/no pattern.

section.title: List of Figures
section.p: The list of figuresList of Figures (lof.xhtml) collects all <fig> elements with titles from your content. Each entry shows the figure number and title, hyperlinked to the figure's location.
Figure numbering is controlled by epub.figure.numbering:

ul.li: global (default) — sequential across the entire book (Figure 1, 2, 3...)

section.p: Controlled by epub.generate.lof. In auto mode, generated when a <figurelist> is present in <booklists>.

section.title: List of Tables
section.p: The list of tablesList of Tables (lot.xhtml) works identically to the List of Figures but for <table> elements with titles. Numbering follows epub.table.numbering with the same global or chapter scoping.
Controlled by epub.generate.lot. In auto mode, generated when a <tablelist> is present in <booklists>.

section.title: Cross-Topic Numbering
section.p: figure numberingcross-topicWhen epub.figure.numbering=global, figure numbers are sequential across the entire publication (Figure 1, Figure 2, Figure 3...). The plugin pre-scans all topics in the map to compute numbering offsets before generating content, ensuring each topic receives the correct starting number.
When epub.figure.numbering=chapter, numbering resets within each chapter using a compound format (Figure 1.1, Figure 1.2, Figure 2.1...). The same logic applies to epub.table.numbering.

section.title: EPUB Semantic Roles
section.p: DPUB-ARIA rolesAll generated pages receive EPUB 3.3 structural semantics via epub:type attributes and epub:typeDPUB-ARIA landmark roles for accessibility:

ul.li: Footnote references — role="doc-noteref" with doc-backlink return links

section.p: These roles enable screen readers and assistive technologies to navigate directly to structural landmarks within the publication.
